name: Good Morning Motherf*ckers

boost.name: AsaCoco Wake-Up
effect: Draw a card, then you may discard a card to gain Advantage (you take the next turn regardless of who initiated the Strike).
HIT: Move 1 space and your opponent discards a card at random.
description: 招牌台詞『Good morning motherf*ckers！』作為高速先制攻擊，象徵她每天早上6點的AsaCoco晨間新聞，以迅雷不及掩耳的速度喚醒對手並造成混亂。

name: Dragon Tail Sweep

boost.name: Tail Buttplug
effect: Move 1 space and Strike. If you switched sides, opponent discards a card at random.
HIT: Push the opponent 2 spaces. You may close the distance by 1 space.
description: 龍尾橫掃攻擊，參考她的招牌尾巴（被粉絲戲稱為buttplug）以及她身高180cm的優勢，以長距離尾部攻擊將對手推開，體現她的龍族本質。

name: Kaichou's Command

boost.name: Tatsunoko Assembly
effect: Add up to 2 cards from your hand to your Gauge, then draw until you have 4 cards in hand.
BEFORE: Your opponent reveals their hand. Choose one card; they must discard it or discard 2 at random.
description: 桐生會會長的號令，展現她的領導力與組織能力。參考她身為桐生會會長的身份以及粉絲名Tatsunoko（小龍），能夠調度資源並指揮作戰。

name: AsaCoco Overdose

boost.name: Prescription Strength
effect: +3 Power and Ignore Armor, but at the end of this Strike take 2 damage.
BEFORE: You may spend up to 3 life for +1 Power per life spent.
HIT: Gain Advantage (you take the next turn regardless of who initiated the Strike).
description: 參考AsaCoco藥物迷因系列，使用後獲得強大強化但伴隨副作用。體現她直播中大膽挑戰邊界的精神——高風險高回報，過量使用會出現各種誇張症狀。

name: Reddit Shitpost

boost.name: Meme Review
effect: Look at the top 3 cards of your opponent's deck. Discard one and rearrange the rest. Draw a card.
Ignore Guard.
HIT: Your opponent discards a card at random and you gain 1 life.
description: 參考她的招牌Reddit迷因回顧節目，以海外網路迷因作為心理攻擊。能夠繞過對手的防禦並擾亂其牌組，象徵她作為JP與EN粉絲橋樑的獨特地位。

name: Coco Kaine

boost.name: Identity Crisis
effect: Name a card. Your opponent reveals their hand. If they have it, add this card to your Gauge and draw 2 cards. If not, draw 1 card.
HIT: Copy the effect text of the top card of your opponent's discard pile until end of turn.
description: 參考Coco Kaine分身設定——如果在美國發展的分身會是中年大叔形象。這張卡片以極速和模仿能力為特色，象徵她的雙語能力和在海外市場的影響力，能夠複製對手的招式。

name: Dragon Breath

boost.name: Incinerate
effect: +2 Power and attacks at range 4-6 cannot be guarded.
Ignore Armor.
BEFORE: You may discard a card to make this attack unblockable.
description: 西方龍的招牌能力——龍息火焰遠程攻擊。參考她設定中是真正的西方龍（7公尺龍型態），以超高溫火焰從遠處焚燒對手，無視裝甲。

name: KanaCoco Combo

boost.name: Bickering Couple
effect: +1 Armor and AFTER: Gain Advantage (you take the next turn regardless of who initiated the Strike). Discard this boost at end of turn.
HIT: You may add a card from your discard to your Gauge.
AFTER: Move 1 space.
description: 參考她與天音かなた的KanaCoco夫妻檔組合。兩人被形容為吵鬧的夫妻檔（夫婦喧嘩），這張卡片體現她們之間的默契與互補，通過合作獲得額外優勢。

name: Blue Super Chat Flush

boost.name: Tatsunoko Donation Drive
effect: Add up to 3 cards from your hand to your Gauge. For each card added, gain 2 life.
BEFORE: +1 Power for each card in your Gauge (max +5).
HIT: Draw a card for each point of damage dealt.
description: 參考Tatsunoko（小龍們）的藍色Super Chat刷屏傳統。藍色Super Chat大量湧入聊天室的畫面成為Coco台的招牌景觀，展現粉絲的忠誠與財力。作為Ultra卡，能夠利用蓄積的資源（Gauge）發動毀滅性打擊。

name: Kiseki Musubi

boost.name: Thank You, Tatsunoko
effect: Regain 5 life. Until the end of your next turn, you have Stun Immunity.
Stun Immunity.
BEFORE: You may discard any number of cards. +1 Power and +1 Speed per card discarded.
AFTER: If this attack hit, gain Advantage.
description: 參考她的畢業原創曲〈Kiseki Musubi〉（奇跡結び）。這張卡片代表她作為Hololive成員的巔峰與告別——凝聚所有力量發動最後一擊。高成本但效果強大，象徵她畢業時491,000人同時觀看的傳奇場面以及與粉絲的羈絆。
